thread:
asha (CSM): Greenline's product org just spun up an 'Insights' internal QA squad and they're ingesting ~8k docs/day for streaming summaries. Embeddings qps jumped on our dashboard. Can we flag as expansion signal and propose options? cc @tom (SE) @luis (AE)

 tom (SE): Yep I see it — embeddings +120% in 24h on their account. Any idea if it's batch or realtime? We need their peak qps and payload distribution.

 asha (CSM): They said workspace `insights-qa` started yesterday. Sample payload they sent:

`````
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "open-embed-1",
  "input_count": 8000
}
`````

They also have a realtime summarization endpoint hitting chat/generate streams.

 maggie (Onboarding): For predictable perf I'd recommend a Dedicated pilot + KV prefix cache for summaries. I can run a capacity plan — need peak concurrent streams and retention window. Also need to run a short enablement sesh on batching knobs.

 luis (AE): Greenline is up for renewal next quarter. If onboarding stalls or costs spike they may evaluate alternatives. Let's fast-track a 3-month Dedicated eval and revenue-protecting terms. I'll draft a commercial note.

 tom (SE): From infra side: streaming summaries need lower tail latency — suggest route policy to prefer RTX-4k models + enable prefix KV cache. For realtime endpoints reduce batch_size, keep batch for embeddings. Will prepare config.

 ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4789 — Dedicated pilot request + enablement workshop. https://redwood.example/tickets/CS-4789 :white_check_mark:

 asha (CSM): :thumbsup: I'll propose Tue/Thu next week for the workshop. Also customer reported hallucinations on very long docs — need to capture prompt set and evals.

 maggie (Onboarding): I'll add a quick eval set to Redwood Optimize and enable regression alerts for the pilot.

 tom (SE): Draft infra config for the SE/ops handoff:

`````
route_policies:
  - name: insights-qa-low-latency
    prefer_models: ["rtx-4k","redwood-low-latency"]
    kv_cache: true
    batch_for: embeddings: 1024, summaries: 8
`````

 asha (CSM): Great — tracking in the account playbook and linking CS-4789. Will update customer after we confirm pilot parameters.

 luis (AE): I'll add the renewal note to the account — thanks team.
